sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: European ash (Fraxinus excelsior) is a large deciduous European tree reaching about 40–45 m. It often grows in cool woods on calcareous or base-rich soils.

sections.title: Leaves, flowers and fruit
sections.text: The opposite leaves have 9–13 leaflets. Small flowers without a perianth appear in clusters before the leaves; the winged samaras reach about 3–4 cm.

sections.title: Uses
sections.text: The foliage is used as fodder in some farming practices. The sources consulted do not describe it as human food.
